svg.text: Security group chain (each layer only accepts traffic from the layer in front of it)
sg-alb: allow 443/80 from 0.0.0.0/0 → sg-app: allow 8000 from sg-alb only → sg-db: allow 5432 from sg-app only
Lab (affordable): 1 NAT gateway, single-AZ RDS, 1 task, short log retention, torn down when idle.
Production-style: NAT per AZ, Multi-AZ RDS, ≥2 tasks across AZs, autoscaling, WAF, rollback on failed deploy.
Dashed outline = production option, not built in the lab. Not HA until built and failover-tested.

svg.text: HTTPS :443 via IGW to ALB; TLS ends at ALB
ALB forwards to a healthy task on :8000
App queries RDS on :5432 over TLS; reply returns
GitHub OIDC token → STS temporary credentials
